newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek PM enters hospital for gallstone operation.
newsitem.headline: Greek PM enters hospital for gallstone operation.

text.p: Greek Prime Minister Costas Simitis was admitted to an Athens state hospital on Saturday for an operation to remove a gallstone, hospital officials said.
"Everything will go ok," a smiling Simitis told reporters as he entered the hospital accompanied by his wife Daphne.
The officials described the operation as simple and said Simitis, 60, should be able return home on Sunday.
A medical bulletin on the results of the operation was expected in about four hours.
